_what: THE INCUMBENT FORMAT'S GATE NUMBERS. These are the pinned D15 numbers, written down here rather than left as defaults inside scripts/cpcv.mjs so that a per-format gate reads every format the same way -- `data/formats/<key>/golden.json` for a built format, this file for the incumbent (whose model files live at the data/ root).
_playoffPct: PRIMARY GATE (D13): the axis the season sim has measured skill on (playoff Brier 0.2370 vs uniform 0.2451). Source: data/experiments.jsonl config_hash e625249e, full_set_baseline_playoff_pct 96.107, at benchDiscount 0.25 / consensusBlend 0 -- both title-edges demoted (D14/D15), so this pre-edge base IS the shipped posture.
_titlePct: SECONDARY / CONTEXT ONLY, never gated: the sim has NO measured skill on the single-elim title (title Brier 0.0659 vs uniform 0.0652, P16 FAILED). RE-PINNED 38.5 -> 38.0 on 2026-09-24 (owner sign-off): the backtest's age/opportunity multipliers became opt-in (review 2026-09-24 B6) because each was ONE fit over every season applied to 1999-2024 -- look-ahead. Measured 37.973% titles / 96.107% playoffs over 3750 trials, per-season line in docs/architecture-review-2026-09-24-modeling.md section 6; the playoff gate value is unchanged. Previously ledger e625249e full_set_baseline_pct 38.48. The old title-tuned posture (--consensus-blend 1 --bench-discount 0.35) was 97.0 / 42.3.
_tolerancePp: +/- pp of Monte-Carlo slack on the consistency check, unchanged from cpcv.mjs's --golden-tol default.
_rePin_2026_09_24_D37: RE-PINNED 96.0/38.0 -> 85.6/22.6 on 2026-09-24 (owner sign-off, D37). Under --no-lookahead the arbiter gave US last season's actuals EXACTLY while the room saw them through a shared N(0, 0.30) error -- a built-in information edge that saturated the gate at 96% playoffs. Our error is now the room's scale, correlated with the room's draw at --our-rho 0.5 (an ASSUMPTION); bot bid noise is keyed per (player, seat); the rookie pool is the whole draft class. Measured 85.600% playoffs / 22.560% titles over 3750 trials; the legacy flags (--our-info clean --bot-noise-sequential --rookies-played-only) reproduce the previous 96.107/37.973 line byte-for-byte. Paired attribution: our-info -10.59pp playoffs [-12.40,-8.77]; keyed noise +0.21 [-1.44,2.03]; draft-class rookies -0.32 [-1.63,0.96].
